notes.title: Pawsky Goes Global with New Languages!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484376/3eb0a8370a7655bcba3feb5ff1bef186eff6e699.jpg[/img]
Hello! I'm thrilled to announce that Pawsky has expanded its reach with new language support! You can now enjoy the game in:
[list]
[b][*] German
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] Korean
[*] Spanish
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Polish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Latvian[/b]
[/list]
Dive into the adorable and exciting world of Pawsky in your native language. This update brings our community closer together, making the game more accessible and fun for players worldwide.
Thank you for your support, and start your adventure today!

notes.title: Status Progress Update
notes.content:
Pawsky has hit [b]100[/b] wishlists! ːsteamhappyː

It may not seem like much, but every milestone counts!
In other news, say hello to a new character joining the story:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45484376/abbd290e1e549ab9241bf1e9c9eac219dd2d5ac0.jpg[/img]

That’s all for now—see you soon in [b]Pawsky[/b]!
